import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, ptr;
        int src, sink;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            src = s;
            sink = t;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), cap));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, g.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long result = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(src, (long) 1e18);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        String[] grid = new String[n];
        int start_y = -1, start_x = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    start_y = i;
                    start_x = j;
                }
            }
        }

        br.readLine(); // dummy line
        br.readLine(); // dummy line

        String[] exits = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            exits[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{start_y, start_x});
        dist[start_y][start_x] = 0;

        int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int y = cell[0];
            int x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                if (dist[ny][nx] != -1 || grid[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y') continue;
                dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
                if (dist[ny][nx] < T) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = T;
                    else dist[i][j] = Math.min(dist[i][j], T);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] node_id = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(node_id[i], -1);
        }
        int node_count = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    node_id[i][j] = node_count++;
                }
                c = exits[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    node_id[i][j] = node_count++;
                }
            }
        }

        int source = 0, sink = node_count + 1;
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(node_count + 2, source, sink);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(source, node_id[i][j], c - '0');
                }

                c = exits[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(node_id[i][j], sink, c - '0');
                }

                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dy[d];
                    int nj = j + dx[d];
                    if (ni < 0 || ni >= n || nj < 0 || nj >= n) continue;
                    if (grid[ni].charAt(nj) == 'Y' || grid[ni].charAt(nj) == 'Z') continue;

                    if (node_id[i][j] != -1 && node_id[ni][nj] != -1) {
                        flow.addEdge(node_id[i][j], node_id[ni][nj], (long) 1e9);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.maxFlow());
    }
}
